meta.name: The Sympathizer
meta.description:
Near the end of the Vietnam War, a spy who was embedded in the South Vietnam army flees to the United States and takes up residence in a refugee community, where he continues to gather intelligence and report back to the Viet Cong.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Death Wish
videos.overview: With the fall of Saigon imminent, the Captain juggles the communist party, the South Vietnamese army, his CIA handler and his conscience.

videos.title: Good Little Asian
videos.overview: As he adjusts to life in Los Angeles, the Captain is forced to find someone to implicate when the General begins to suspect a mole.

videos.title: Love It or Leave It
videos.overview: The Captain and Bon craft a plan to quell the General's anxieties. Later, the Captain meets the Auteur, who wants to make a film about war.

videos.title: Give Us Some Good Lines
videos.overview: As a reluctant consultant on a Hollywood film, the Captain navigates the egos and personalities of an increasingly chaotic production.

videos.title: All for One
videos.overview: After a lengthy stint at the hospital, the Captain discovers that the General has started recruiting for a secret military operation.

videos.title: The Oriental Mode of Destruction
videos.overview: Convinced that the General's military operation is doomed, the Captain searches for ways to expose the mission and save Bon.

videos.title: Endings Are Hard, Aren't They?
videos.overview: Back in Vietnam, the Captain is forced to tell his story… and confront the decisions that haunt his past.
